Lowercase letters, digits and _, starting with a letter, at most 64; one name per cluster. broker.identity.machines.[].jwks string k8s only, required: the https URL the cluster's signing keys are read from, typically the API server's /openid/v1/jwks. broker.identity.machines.[].namespaces list of string k8s only, required: the namespaces whose service accounts this cluster may name, by name. broker.identity.machines.[].directory.kind string x509 only: how a workload certificate finds its directory entry. Must be spiffe_id. Needs broker.directory. broker.identity.machines.[].directory.attribute string x509 only: the directory attribute that holds the SPIFFE ID. Required, no default, and not the attribute broker.directory uses for username_attribute or principal_attribute. broker.identity.machines.[].directory.allow_weak boolean x509 only: acknowledges that this mapping is weak. Required to be true, with issuers. broker.identity.machines.[].directory.issuers list of string x509 only: the RFC 4514 issuer DNs the workload certificate's issuer must be one of. Required. broker.identity.machines.[].directory.user_filter string x509 only: the LDAP filter for the entry lookup. Default broker.directory.user_filter. broker.identity.clock_skew duration How far a token's time claims may differ from the broker's clock. Default 1m; 0s to 5m. Needs a restart. broker.identity.max_token_age duration The oldest an ID token may be, by its issue time, and still be accepted. Default 2h; 5m to 24h. Needs a restart. broker.identity.jwks_refresh_interval duration How often each provider's signing keys are re-fetched. Default 1h; 5m to 24h. Needs a restart. broker.identity.jwks_max_age duration How long fetched keys are trusted without a successful refresh. Default 24h; 10m to 720h; at least twice jwks_refresh_interval, so one missed refresh does not refuse every token. Needs a restart. broker.identity.issuance.certificate_lifetime duration Lifetime of the certificate the broker issues after a sign-in. Default 12h; 1h to 24h. Writing issuance: {} turns issuance on with this default. Issuance needs a human oidc or directory_password verifier, and a directory_password sign-in needs it. Needs a restart. broker.identity.per_login_mfa.hardware_key_touch.attestation_roots_file string The PEM roots a touch key's attestation chains to. Required when hardware_key_touch is present. SIGHUP re-reads it; a file that does not load keeps the roots in force. broker.identity.per_login_mfa.idp_mfa.amr list of string Authentication method references the identity provider's ID token may carry as proof of the second factor. Default [mfa]; none may be empty. Counts only beside an x509 humans verifier. Needs a restart. broker.identity.per_login_mfa.idp_mfa.acr_values string The acr_values the sign-in sends to the provider. Needs a restart. broker.policy_file string Path of the policy file this process admits from. Required. It is watched every policy_watch_interval and re-read at SIGHUP; a file that does not load is refused and the policy in force keeps serving. The file and its directory must be writable by port49's user or root alone. broker.batch_max integer The most devices in one mint request; a larger sweep pages. Default 100; 1 to 1000. Needs a restart. broker.policy_watch_interval duration How often the policy file is read for a change. A change is loaded once two reads in a row agree, so an edit takes effect within two intervals and a write in progress is not loaded part-way. Default 5s; 1s to 5m. SIGHUP loads what is on disk at once. Write the file atomically: a temporary file renamed over it. A change to this key needs a restart. broker.revocations_file string port49d.yaml only (refused in port49-broker.yaml): where port49d keeps the revocations port49 revoke puts in force, so a restart forgets none. Required in a broker: block, which port49d.yaml accepts only on the memory store. Its directory must exist and be writable by port49's user or root alone, and the name may not be a symlink. port49d never creates it: run port49d init-revocations once per install. port49d rewrites it, mode 0600 and atomically, after every revocation and lift. Needs a restart. broker.max_conns_per_principal integer The most broker connections one principal may hold; a new one closes the oldest idle one, and is refused with 503 when all are busy. Default 4; 1 to 64. Needs a restart. broker.max_pending_conns_per_source integer The most broker connections one address may hold that are not yet bound to a principal; the next is reset. Default 16; 1 to 256. Needs a restart. broker.certificate_status.disabled boolean Set true to check no revocation status. Then none of crls, ocsp, refresh_interval and on_unavailable may be set. The block is required: leaving it out is refused, so skipping the check is always a written choice. Needs a restart. broker.certificate_status.crls.[].name string Name of this revocation list source: lowercase letters, digits and _, starting with a letter, at most 64, and unique in the block. It names the kept file crl-<name>.der and the crl_next_update metric label. broker.certificate_status.crls.[].file string Path of a CRL file. Set exactly one of file and url. broker.certificate_status.crls.[].url string An http or https URL to fetch the CRL from. Set exactly one of file and url. broker.certificate_status.crls.[].issuer_file string Required. The CA certificate that signs the list: the trust anchor, or a certificate the anchor signed. broker.certificate_status.ocsp.responder string An http or https URL of a fixed OCSP responder. Set this or use_aia: true. broker.certificate_status.ocsp.use_aia boolean Set true to ask each certificate's own OCSP responder, from its Authority Information Access extension. Set this or responder. broker.certificate_status.ocsp.timeout duration How long one OCSP request may take. Default 2s; 100ms to 10s. broker.certificate_status.ocsp.hash string The hash of the OCSP CertID: sha256 (default) or sha1. broker.certificate_status.refresh_interval duration How often the revocation lists are fetched or re-read. Default 10m; 1m to 24h. broker.certificate_status.on_unavailable string What to do when a certificate's status cannot be established: refuse (default) refuses the connection, allow admits it and says so. broker.state_dir string port49-broker.yaml only (refused as a key of port49d.yaml): absolute path of a directory that exists and that neither its group nor others can write (create it mode 0700), where port49-broker keeps the CRLs it verified and its other state. Required under the broker's role, which has no revocations file. It may not be inside inventory.service.state_dir or mirror_dir, nor hold them. Needs a restart. broker.directory.servers.[].uri string An ldaps:// or ldap:// URI with a host, and no credentials in it. Plain ldap:// needs start_tls: true. Two servers may not share host and port. At least one server is required. Needs a restart. broker.directory.servers.[].priority integer Among servers of the preferred site, the one with the higher number is preferred. Default 0. Needs a restart. broker.directory.servers.[].site string The site this server belongs to. When the broker's own site is known, servers of that site are tried first. Needs a restart. broker.directory.servers.[].start_tls boolean Upgrade an ldap:// connection with StartTLS. Refused on an ldaps:// URI. Needs a restart. broker.directory.site string The site this broker runs in. Overrides site_env. Servers whose site matches are preferred. Needs a restart. broker.directory.site_env string Name of the environment variable that holds the site when site is not set. Default PORT49_SITE. It may not be the variable bind.password_secret_ref reads, because the site is logged. Needs a restart. broker.directory.ca_file string PEM CA that verifies the directory servers' certificates. Required, and it must be readable. Needs a restart. broker.directory.bind.mechanism string How the broker authenticates to the directory: external (a TLS client certificate), gssapi (Kerberos) or simple (a DN and password). Required. Needs a restart. broker.directory.bind.tls_cert_file string external only, required: the client certificate. Needs a restart. broker.directory.bind.tls_key_file string external only, required: the client certificate's key. It must be owned by port49's user or root, with no group or other mode bit. Needs a restart. broker.directory.bind.keytab_file string gssapi only, required: the Kerberos keytab. Needs a restart. broker.directory.bind.principal string gssapi only, required: the Kerberos principal to bind as. Needs a restart. broker.directory.bind.krb5_conf string gssapi only, required: path of the krb5.conf to use. Needs a restart. broker.directory.bind.bind_dn string simple only, required: the DN to bind as. Needs a restart. broker.directory.bind.password_secret_ref secret reference simple only, required: where the bind password is read from, env:NAME or file:/absolute/path. It is read when the directory opens, not when the file is checked. Needs a restart. broker.directory.base_dn string Required. The base DN people are searched under; it must parse as an RFC 4514 DN. Needs a restart. broker.directory.groups_base_dn string The base DN groups are searched under. Default base_dn. Needs a restart. broker.directory.user_filter string LDAP filter for a person's entry; it must compile. Default (objectClass=person). Needs a restart. broker.directory.group_filter string LDAP filter for a group; it must compile. Default (\|(objectClass=group)(objectClass=groupOfNames)). Needs a restart. broker.directory.principal_attribute string The attribute that holds a person's principal. Default userPrincipalName. Must be an attribute name or OID. Needs a restart. broker.directory.username_attribute string The attribute that holds the username a device sees. Default sAMAccountName. Needs a restart. broker.directory.group_name_attribute string The attribute that names a group. Default cn. Needs a restart. broker.directory.member_attribute string The attribute that lists a group's members. Default member. Needs a restart. broker.directory.certificate_mapping.kind string How a client certificate finds its entry: issuer_serial, sid, san_upn, san_email, subject_dn or cn. Required when an x509 human verifier is configured, optional otherwise. issuer_serial and sid are strong; the others are weak and need allow_weak and issuers. Needs a restart. broker.directory.certificate_mapping.attribute string The entry attribute the mapping looks up. Default by kind: altSecurityIdentities for issuer_serial, objectSid for sid, userPrincipalName for san_upn, mail for san_email, distinguishedName for subject_dn, cn for cn. Pointing a strong kind at another attribute makes it weak. Needs a restart. broker.directory.certificate_mapping.allow_weak boolean Acknowledges a weak mapping. Required true for a weak kind or a repointed strong one, with issuers. Needs a restart. broker.directory.certificate_mapping.issuers list of string RFC 4514 issuer DNs the mapping is pinned to. Required for a weak or repointed mapping. Needs a restart. broker.directory.nested_groups string How nested group membership is resolved. Required: in_chain (Active Directory's chain matching), recursive (port49 walks member_attribute) or direct (groups are flat). Needs a restart. broker.directory.max_depth integer How deep recursive nesting is followed. Default 16; 1 to 64. Needs a restart. broker.directory.query_timeout duration How long one directory query may take. Default 5s; 1s to 30s. Needs a restart. broker.directory.health_check.interval duration How often each server is checked. Default 30s; 5s to 5m. Needs a restart. broker.directory.health_check.timeout duration How long one check may take; at most interval. Default 2s. Needs a restart. broker.directory.circuit_breaker.failure_threshold integer Consecutive failures that open a server's circuit. Default 3; 1 to 20. Needs a restart. broker.directory.circuit_breaker.probe_interval duration How often an open circuit is probed. Default 1m; 5s to 10m. Needs a restart. broker.directory.failback.stability_window duration How long a preferred server must stay healthy before the broker moves back to it. Default 5m; 0s to 1h. Needs a restart. broker.directory.grace duration When no directory server answers, the membership stored from the last good lookup is used if it was verified no longer ago than this; older than this, the principal is refused directory_unavailable. A refusal the directory already gave is never overruled. Default 4h; 0s to 24h; not above session.staleness_ceiling when both run in one process. Needs a restart. broker.directory.prewarm.interval duration How often the broker pre-verifies every known principal. Default 1h; 0s turns it off; otherwise 5m to 24h. Needs a restart. broker.directory.prewarm.max_principals integer The most principals one pre-warm pass verifies. People and, under a workload mapping, workloads each take up to it, so one interval verifies up to twice it. Default 10000; 1 to 1000000. Needs a restart. broker.refresh_interval duration How often the broker re-verifies every live principal and stamps refreshed_at. Default 5m; 1m to 1h. In one process with session.staleness_ceiling it may not exceed half of it. Needs a restart.

docs.title: lab
docs.text: Key Type Description lab.session_attributes list of string Test lab only; leave it out in production. Attributes attached to a permitted session authorization reply of a seeded context. Not accepted in port49-broker.yaml. Needs a restart. lab.command_attributes list of string Test lab only. Attributes attached to a permitted per-command authorization reply, a separate list from session_attributes because the lab asks the same question of each reply separately. Not accepted in port49-broker.yaml. Needs a restart. lab.deny_prefixes list of string Test lab only. Commands the lab denies by prefix, matched on a token boundary: show denies show version but not shower. Not accepted in port49-broker.yaml. Needs a restart. lab.fault_file string Test lab only. A file naming the fault in force. Its contents are read each time the switch is checked, so editing it takes effect at once; an absent file means no fault. Not accepted in port49-broker.yaml. The path itself needs a restart. lab.seed_token_file string Test lab only. Where port49d writes the token pairs it mints for seed_tokens, one JSON object per line, mode 0600. Required when seed_tokens is non-empty. Needs a restart. lab.seed_tokens.[].nas string Test lab only. The device address the seeded token is for. Required. lab.seed_tokens.[].username string Test lab only. The username the seeded token is for. Required. lab.seed_tokens.[].enable boolean Test lab only. true also mints an enable token beside the login one. lab.deny_message_length integer Test lab only. Pads the lab's deny server_msg to this many bytes with a counting pattern. 0 leaves it; otherwise 16 to 4096. Not accepted in port49-broker.yaml. Needs a restart. lab.deny_session boolean Test lab only. Fails every session authorization of a seeded context with the padded deny message. Not accepted in port49-broker.yaml. Needs a restart.

docs.title: inventory
docs.text: Key Type Description inventory.max_removed_percent integer The most devices, as a percentage of the devices in force, an inventory reload may take out of service (removed, or kept and newly refused). A reload that takes more is refused and the previous inventory keeps serving. Default 10; 0 refuses every removal; 100 turns the bound off. An empty inventory is refused whatever this says. SIGHUP re-reads this key, so a deliberate large removal needs no restart: raise it, send SIGHUP, lower it again. inventory.service.url string Where port49d takes its inventory from when the inventory service publishes it, in place of inventory_file: https://host[:port] with no user information, path, query or fragment. Needs a policy. Needs a restart. inventory.service.ca_file string Absolute path of the PEM CA that verifies the service's certificate. Required; without it any public CA could vouch for the service. Needs a restart. inventory.service.tls_cert_file string Absolute path of port49d's client certificate for the service, presented over mutual TLS. Required. Needs a restart. inventory.service.tls_key_file string Absolute path of the client certificate's key. Required; owned by port49's user or root, no group or other mode bit. Needs a restart. inventory.service.verify_key_files list of string Absolute paths of the service's signing public keys: two while its key rotates. At least one is required. Every document, from the service or from disk, is verified against them. SIGHUP re-reads the list. inventory.service.poll_interval duration How often port49d asks the service for the bundle's version. Default 30s; 5s to 10m. Needs a restart. inventory.service.state_dir string Absolute directory that holds the last document port49d applied, so a restart starts from it with no service. Required, and outside mirror_dir. Needs a restart. inventory.service.mirror_dir string Optional absolute directory of the shared copy the service writes, read at a cold start when state_dir has none. Outside state_dir. Needs a restart.

docs.title: stores
docs.text: Key Type Description stores.directory.backend string Where records live: memory (default) or etcd. A store block on etcd also needs its etcd block; etcd in port49d.yaml needs policy: and no broker: block, and port49-broker.yaml must use etcd. Needs a restart. stores.directory.packet_deadline duration Bounds all store work for one TACACS+ packet, so a device hears an answer before its own timeout. Default 2s; 100ms to 2s; for the session store at least etcd.call_timeout. Needs a restart. stores.directory.etcd.endpoints list of string etcd endpoints, each https://host:port with no user information, path, query or fragment. At least one. port49 authenticates to etcd by client certificate. stores.directory.etcd.ca_file string Absolute path of the PEM CA that verifies etcd's certificate. Required. stores.directory.etcd.prefix string The keyspace prefix. Default /port49/; it must start with /. stores.directory.etcd.daemon.cert_file string port49d's client certificate for etcd. docs.title: policy
docs.text: Key Type Description policy.file string Path of the policy file a port49d with no broker: block admits from. Required when policy: is present. Refused beside a broker: block, whose policy is broker.policy_file. Re-read every watch_interval and at SIGHUP. policy.watch_interval duration How often the policy file is read for a change. Default 5s; 1s to 5m. A change to this key needs a restart.

docs.title: key_secret_refs
docs.text: Key Type Description key_secret_refs.env_prefix string A policy's key secret_ref: env:NAME may name only variables that begin with this prefix, so a policy writer cannot pick which of the host's secrets becomes a TACACS+ key. Default PORT49_KEY_; at least 4 characters of a variable name, ending in _. Needs a restart. key_secret_refs.file_dir string A policy's key secret_ref: file:/path may name only files under this directory. Default /run/port49/keys; an absolute, clean path below /. Needs a restart.

docs.title: port49-broker.yaml
docs.text:
port49-broker.yaml has the schema above, read under the broker's role. The broker never speaks TACACS+ and never holds a device key, so the loader refuses the keys below by name: a file that names one does not load, and the error names the key. A few other keys are refused by the check of their own block rather than by this table; the entries above mark them "port49d.yaml only".

Refused key Why listen port49-broker never speaks TACACS+; that is port49d's tls_listener port49-broker never speaks TACACS+; that is port49d's keys device keys are the policy file's keys: block key_secret_refs port49-broker reads key names, never a key's secret accounting accounting is port49d's limits TACACS+ limits are port49d's receipt_idle_ttl receipts are port49d's receipt_max_age receipts are port49d's platforms session services are port49d's policy port49-broker's policy is broker.policy_file broker.revocations_file on etcd the store keeps the marks (decision 36); remove it stores.directory.etcd.daemon the daemon's etcd identity is port49d's alone stores.session.etcd.daemon the daemon's etcd identity is port49d's alone lab.fault_file the lab's fault switch is port49d's lab.session_attributes the lab's answers are port49d's lab.command_attributes the lab's answers are port49d's lab.deny_prefixes the lab's answers are port49d's lab.deny_message_length the lab's answers are port49d's lab.deny_session the lab's answers are port49d's
